tagline: A little curiosity. A closer connection.
eyebrow: FOR THE PEOPLE YOU KNOW. AND THE THINGS YOU DON’T.
heroBody: Small questions can open big conversations. Nuance is a place to discover what makes you, your friends, and your favourite people wonderfully different.
note: We’re building something thoughtful. Quizzes are coming next.
cardQuestion: What makes you feel most understood?
howBody: A playful way to make room for another point of view.
step1Body: Choose a quiz, on your own or with 2–10 people.
step2Body: Everyone answers independently. There’s no race.
step3Body: Group results stay private until everyone finishes.
catalogTitle: Good conversations are on their way.
catalogBody: The quiz collection is not active yet. We’re preparing thoughtful questions in English, Ukrainian, and French.
privacyBody: Nuance is in development. No quizzes or answers are collected yet. Accounts use essential session cookies. Future guest answers will expire after seven days. Sharing will always need your consent.
footer: Made for connection. Built with care.
